description: HEL-1308 seam fixture: the duration display format vocabulary. `lists` are the exact ordered vocabularies the frontend readers, the backend OutputFormatVocabulary and helio-mcp must all expose. `vocabularyDoc` is the exact sentence appended to the backend KeysDoc and helio-mcp OUTPUT_CONFIG_KEYS_DOC; `schemaDescriptions` are the exact `format` / `columnFormats` property descriptions of the three Output request schemas. `configs` are accepted and stored unchanged by the backend and read losslessly by the frontend. `valueCases` pin the displayed text.
vocabularyDoc: Display formats: a metric or collection `format` is one of number, integer, currency, percent, duration, durationMs (duration reads seconds, durationMs reads milliseconds); a table `columnFormats` entry is { type, decimals?, currency?, datePattern?, unit? } where type is one of number, currency, date, text, duration, and unit (duration only) is one of s, ms (default s).

schemaDescriptions.format: Metric and collection kinds. One of number, integer, currency, percent, duration, durationMs (duration reads seconds, durationMs reads milliseconds).
schemaDescriptions.columnFormats: Table kind only. Column name -> { type, decimals?, currency?, datePattern?, unit? }; type is one of number, currency, date, text, duration; unit (duration only) is one of s, ms (default s).
